text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...My goodness! The new menu item is a 
chocolate melon parfait...! What an 
exquisitely sweet combination!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, but my weight... Desserts are strictly 
forbidden, strictly forbidden...!
(*Grumble~...*)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This will not do, desu wa...! At times 
like this, I must discipline both mind and 
body through training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haa... Phew~... I ran far more intensely 
than usual, desu wa. I must ensure proper 
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Fatigue... recovery...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ikuno-san! Please scold me, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Scold you, you say...? Whatever 
for...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see... So using fatigue recovery as an 
excuse, you ended up eating a parfait.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I despair at my own weakness... Therefore, 
please, scold this foolish girl severely! 
Desu wa...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. If you insist that much. I 
cannot guarantee how well I can do it, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san, please manage your weight 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno-san, that is far too gentle...! 
Please reprimand me more sternly!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, young lady! What do ya think 
you're doin' wolfing down parfaits?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Still not enough, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: McQueen! You are slacking off!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: One more time, with more feeling!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A scolding method that truly resonates 
with McQueen-san's heart... To ensure she 
does not repeat this mistake—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Do you dare call yourself a horse girl of 
the Mejiro family...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-It feels just as if Grandmother were 
scolding me... Yes... A horse girl of the 
Mejiro—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I must return my weight to normal at all 
costs! From now on, I shall exercise 
utmost self-restraint with all my spirit!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If I ever go over my weight limit, make 
sure you scold me in return, McQueen-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Me scold Ikuno-san?! I-I shall do my very 
best, desu wa!

One day, I spotted Mejiro McQueen walking 
proudly through the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Temptations of this level will not break 
my resolve! Ikuno-san, you have my deepest 
gratitude... desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As a horse girl of the Mejiro family, I 
will ensure I never make such a blunder 
again.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Do your best. I will be rooting for 
you.

One day, I spotted Mejiro McQueen walking 
proudly through the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Temptations of this level will not break 
my resolve! Ikuno-san, you have my deepest 
gratitude... desu wa!
